title: ReconPotBench: Evaluating LLM Honeypots in Multi-Round Linux Reconnaissance
abstract: arXiv:2611.20528v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to build interactive honeypots, yet existing evaluations mainly assess isolated command outputs and cannot determine whether a system remains believable when later commands depend on earlier results. We present ReconPotBench, a multi-round benchmark for Linux reconnaissance honeypots. It contains 1{,}032 three-round reconnaissance interactions across eight reconnaissance categories, with reference outputs collected from a real Linux environment. Under a unified testing protocol, we compare Cowrie, open-source LLMs, and closed-source LLMs along three dimensions: round-level authenticity, cross-round contextual consistency, and hacker-oriented reconnaissance value. translated_title: ReconPotBench：在多轮Linux侦察中评估LLM蜜罐
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于构建交互式蜜罐，然而现有的评估主要针对孤立的命令输出，无法判断当后续命令依赖先前结果时，系统是否仍然可信。我们提出了ReconPotBench，这是一个针对Linux侦察蜜罐的多轮基准测试。它包含1,032个跨八个侦察类别的三轮侦察交互，参考输出来自真实Linux环境。在统一的测试协议下，我们从三个维度比较了Cowrie、开源LLM和闭源LLM：轮次级真实性、跨轮上下文一致性以及面向黑客的侦察价值。结果表明，多轮评估能够暴露单轮测试所隐藏的失败，因为真实性会随交互深度的增加而下降，且开源和闭源LLM都难以在多轮交互中维持连贯的状态。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对Linux侦察蜜罐的多轮评估基准ReconPotBench，通过1,032个三轮交互测试证明多轮评估能暴露单轮测试所掩盖的问题，揭示LLM蜜罐在跨轮状态一致性上的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ReconPotBench, a multi-round benchmark for Linux reconnaissance honeypots, showing through 1,032 three-round interactions that multi-round evaluation exposes failures hidden by single-round testing, as LLM honeypots struggle to maintain coherent state across rounds.
